sections.heading: Expeditions and routes
sections.body: A dungeon run generates a map of connected rooms. Complete the current room, then choose from the available route options. The map marks traversed rooms, your current position, and routes that can be selected next.

sections.heading: Vigor and decisions
sections.body: Vigor represents the condition of your expedition and can change as rooms resolve. Room previews and decision text describe known consequences, while forecasts communicate uncertainty. Reaching a failed state ends the expedition.

sections.heading: Pending Loot
sections.body: Rewards collected during a run remain Pending Loot until secured. Completing the dungeon or choosing a safe retreat lets you claim eligible rewards; failing the run loses Pending Loot. Review the warning and current route before continuing.
